Decisions.Title: One proxy in front of every model
Decisions.Body: Agents never call a provider directly. Routing between self-hosted and cloud models lives in one layer, so swapping a model or running an A/B comparison is a configuration change, not a code change.

Decisions.Title: Choose models with evidence
Decisions.Body: Candidate models were benchmarked on real domain queries, comparing tool-call behavior, latency and output quality before choosing one.

Decisions.Title: Observability from day one
Decisions.Body: Every agent session and tool call is traced, which turned latency bottlenecks, hallucination patterns and provider inconsistencies into data instead of anecdotes.

Decisions.Title: Tested under load
Decisions.Body: A containerized harness generated synthetic telemetry at scale to stress the agents and validate detection logic before release.

Experience.Title: Professional experience
Experience.Description: 4+ years building production systems across AI, backend and cloud, from multi-agent LLM pipelines to a university accreditation platform.

Highlights: Principal engineer of ABET 3.0, the university's accreditation platform now in production, on a team of 7. Led the rebuild from legacy .NET / SQL Server to NestJS, TypeORM and PostgreSQL (77 entities, 300 test suites) with a Next.js 16 / React 19 frontend.
Cut the grades export from 26 minutes to 85 seconds by profiling the production query with EXPLAIN ANALYZE, and made PDF generation 4x faster by moving the renderer to a persistent Chromium.

Created abet-plugins, the team's AI-assisted development standard. One shared source of skills, agents and policy rules generates plugins for Claude Code, Codex and opencode, backed by 425 test cases and adopted by all 7 developers.

Designed the CI/CD from scratch with GitHub Actions (a CI gate deploys cannot bypass, cached images on GHCR, Docker Compose deploys, image rollback) and merged backend and frontend into a pnpm monorepo.
Built a Playwright and Puppeteer scraping subsystem with a headful Chromium streamed over noVNC, so staff complete MFA logins live while the scraper reuses the session.
Designed and delivered a multi-agent AI pipeline for real-time network analytics, orchestrating specialized agents with CrewAI and LangGraph.
Built an LLM proxy layer routing between self-hosted and cloud models, enabling model swapping and A/B evaluation.
Added end-to-end LLM observability with Phoenix (Arize), tracing agent sessions and tool calls to find latency bottlenecks and hallucination patterns.
Built Python streaming services that process network telemetry and logs, with runtime-configurable APIs and load testing on synthetic data.
Implemented backend features end to end on Google Cloud (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Firestore), from design to delivery.
Improved reliability with a Redis-based batching system that regulated outbound requests, reducing rate-limit errors (HTTP 429) and stabilizing external API communication.
Automated the internal developer workflow by integrating MCP with JIRA, Confluence and Bitbucket, including automatic PR generation.
Optimized MySQL data access patterns, resolving critical performance issues and significantly reducing response times.
Developed the backend of the FLIT transportation ERP with Java/Spring Boot, implementing JWT authentication and RESTful APIs.
Optimized response times with Data Transfer Objects (DTOs), achieving a 30% latency reduction.
Migrated from basic authentication to JWT with Spring Security, enabling Microsoft Azure SSO integration.
Built frontend components with React/Redux following Domain-Driven Design within Agile/Scrum workflows.
Developed a currency and cryptocurrency exchange platform in Odoo using MVC and OOP with real-time REST API integrations.
Implemented dynamic JavaScript visualizations for trend analysis and a PostgreSQL-backed reporting module for the SBS, Peru's banking regulator.
Built the personnel management system (shift scheduling, payroll, role-based access) as part of a team, with a Django backend serving a Flutter app for staff and an Angular panel for administrators.
Developed the attendance control system end to end with Vue.js and .NET, integrating Azure AD and a third-party facial recognition library to automate clock-in and clock-out.
Implemented cloud infrastructure on AWS with CI/CD, Docker and Kubernetes, improving deployment speed by 60%.
